emails.subject: Employee and channel incentives at Bajaj Finserv
emails.body:
Hi team,

Bajaj Finserv provides financial services across India, including lending, insurance, and wealth management products.

Xoxoday offers a platform to automate employee recognition, sales incentives, and channel partner payouts, which can help streamline reward distribution across large distribution networks.

How are you currently managing sales incentives and partner payouts across your organization?

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com

emails.body:
Hi team,

Best,

emails.body:
Hi team,
